scope: Isolated candidate design and static/offline USD validation only. No Isaac session was launched by this audit and no task source was changed.
candidate_status: Ready for coordinator-scheduled single-process PhysX probe; not ready for task integration.

subsequent_scenarios: kick: initial-condition-only velocity 0.05 rad/s, no per-step drive or state write
floor-contact: actual cube-floor contact events with original cube collision shapes

source_semantics.upstream_requirement: mujoco>=3.1.0 in pyproject and README; this broad minimum does not establish old-version support for current polynomial syntax
source_semantics.original_xml_compilation: Succeeded on installed MuJoCo 3.12.0 without mj_step
source_semantics.ported: linear coefficient a=0.0005 only; b and c omitted

topology.self_collision: Enabled at articulation; retain original joint collisionEnabled=false between Core and each child. Sibling collision response still requires actual validation.
topology.core_inertia: Preserve current USD Core mass/inertia. Do not combine with the separate source-Core-inertia override that previously failed left grasp.

passive_properties.schema: PhysxJointAxisAPI, codeless PhysxSchemaAddition in installed 110.4.4 package
passive_properties.application: prim.CanApplyAPI('PhysxJointAxisAPI', axis); prim.ApplyAPI('PhysxJointAxisAPI', axis); registered GetAttribute(...), require IsCustom()==false
passive_properties.per_step_cube_write_data_to_sim: Never call; only passive authored properties and physics stepping.

facade_integration_requirements: Construct original USD first, then one Articulation rooted at Core. Never construct 27 RigidObjects before adding RootAPI.
Expose data.default_root_state/root_state_w/root_pos_w with existing project quaternion convention and root link pose plus root COM velocity semantics.
Keep model, allow_pose_reset, pose_reset_count, reset(), update(dt), states(), and no-op write_data_to_sim() public behavior.
At episode reset only, write root link pose, root COM velocity and all 66 joint q/qd. Never write non-root world poses independently.
states() maps original body paths/names to articulation body_link_pose_w plus body_com_vel_w, preserving current link-origin position and COM velocity convention.
Use actual backend names/paths; Lab3 joint_ordering=None and body_ordering=None preserve backend ordering. Do not assume 26 USD joints equal 66 backend DOFs.
Expose Core-only body_inertia slice if retaining cube_core_inertia.verify_core_inertia compatibility; do not silently return the whole 27-body tensor.
Apply threshold-zero PhysxContactReportAPI to all 27 original body prims and preserve current callback actor paths. Validate actual callback events after integration.
Reject simultaneous source_joint_damping legacy option: that path authors DriveAPI and converts spheres to D6, which would double-count damping and change this candidate topology.
Keep robot's 56 DOFs, limits, safety/contact gates, scene precision settings and task evidence contracts unchanged. Candidate must repeat actual held-out task gates.
runtime_validation_order: On single Isaac slot, run default freefall. Require one floating articulation, root Core, original 27 body paths, 66 rotational DOFs and no split tree.
Read actual tensor view armature, three friction properties, masses, inertias, COMs, joint types, paths and targets. Fail mismatch; never patch in constants after a failed readback.
Require drive stiffness/damping, targets and actuation force all zero. Preserve Core mass/principal inertia. Save implementation/source/asset hashes.
Validate mass-center ballistic fall and zero-internal-velocity stability for 48 steps. Save every step; no per-step cube commands.
Run isolated initial-velocity kick and floor-contact scenarios to observe passive response and actual contact callbacks. Coupled individual DOF speeds need not decay monotonically.
Verify sibling self-collision response and all spherical axes at larger rotations before promoting the candidate. Small-angle zero-state probe alone does not prove 90-degree face turns.
Only then build new facade and repeat robot grasp/turn development and independent gates. No task success claim from this probe.

primary_sources.supports: articulation-only per-axis passive properties and degree-based USD units
floating-root placement, articulation topology, non-root pose-write limitation
supplementary modern parser mapping and conversion only; not proof of installed Isaac backend behavior
